revenueModel.text: Customers pay ArcBest for freight transportation, logistics, and expedited shipping services, with LTL revenue based on billed revenue per hundredweight including fuel surcharges.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Asset-Based billed revenue per hundredweight, including fuel surcharges, decreased 1.3% for 2025, compared to 2024.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company sold FleetNet America, Inc., which was reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On February 28, 2023, the Company sold FleetNet America, Inc. ("FleetNet"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, for an aggregate adjusted cash purchase price of $100.9 million, including post-closing adjustments.
